verses.text: Haton wal juntzanh cheknab'il yet' k'ayb'ub'al tik yowalil ol he b'eyb'alej ayik ayexxo'ek' t'a lum lum ol yak' Jehová ko Diosal yet' heb' ko mam kicham heyikej.

Ha heb' anima kajan t'a lum lum chi', ch'ok sdiosal heb' b'aj syal sb'a. Ayik toxo ix heyikejel lum slu'um heb' chi', yowalil tze satel juntzanh yik lesal b'aj syal sb'a heb' t'a sdiosal, wach'chom t'a jolomtak witz yet' t'a tzalkixtak yet' t'a yichtak te te' k'ayum xi'il.

Tze mak'poj juntzanh yaltar heb', k'e'en k'e'en yet' te te' b'ob'il sdiosalok heb' skuchan Asera, haton b'aj syak'em sb'a heb'. Tze nhusantz'a'ok, tze mak'anpoj sdiosal heb' chi', yik wach' manhxa b'ak'inh snachajkot t'a juntzanh lugar chi'.
Manh ichok tz'aj yoch heb' ejmelal t'a sdiosal chi', manh ichokta tz'aj heyoch ejmelal t'a Jehová ko Diosal.
Ha t'a jun lugar ol sik'kanel Jehová t'a skal heyinhtilal to yik yaji, hata' ol b'at heyak'em he b'a t'ay.

Ol heyak'an he silab' stz'a smasanil yet' juntzanhxo silab' yuj heyik'ancha'anh Jehová. Ol heyak'anpax he diezmo, he kolwal yet' tas ix heyak' he ti' heyak'ani yet' heyofrenda to tz'el wal t'a he k'o'ol heyak'ani. Hanheja' ol heyak'anpax nok' sb'ab'el yune' he wakax yet' sb'ab'el yune' nok' he kalnel.
Hata' ol hex wa t'a tzalajk'olal t'a yichanh Jehová yet' masanil heb' ay t'a yol he pat. Icha chi' ol aj he wa'an tas tzeyik' t'a he munlajel ha to syal swach'k'olal Jehová ol yak' t'ayex.
Hata' manh ol he k'ulej icha tas sko k'ulej tikne'ik, yujto ha t'a tik yalnhej tas snib'ej junjun anima, ha sk'ulej.
Wal yel manto hex k'ochlaj t'a lum lum ol yak' Jehová t'ayex, hata' manhxalaj tas ol he na'a.

Wanxo sk'och sk'uhal yik ol hex k'axpajek' t'a ha' Jordán, yik tzex k'ochkan t'a sat lum lum ol yak' Jehová heyikej. Ayik toxo ix hex kolchajkanel t'a yol sk'ab' heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayex, manhxa xiwk'olal t'ayex ta'.

Haxo jun lugar ol sik'kanel Jehová yik tz'och yikok, hata' ol heyak' masanil tas ix wal t'ayex to ol he k'ulej. Hata' ol heyak' nok' silab' stz'a'i yet' juntzanh silab' yuj heyik'ancha'anh Jehová chi', he diezmo, he kolwal yet' heyofrenda sik'b'ilel heyu'uj b'aj ix heyak' he ti' heyak'ani.

Tzex te tzalaj t'a yichanh Jehová ko Diosal yet' heb' heyuninal, heb' he chekab' yet' heb' levita ol kajnaj t'a he kal. Yujto ha heb' levita chi' malaj smakb'en heb' ol scha heyet'ok t'a lum lum chi'.
Tzeyil wal he b'a, manh he komon nhusejtz'a nok' he silab' t'a yalnhej tas lugaril he gana.
Anhej t'a jun lugar sik'b'ilel yuj Jehová t'a skal he chonhab' smasanil, hata' tzeyik'b'at he silab' yik tze nhusantz'a'ok yet' he k'anab'ajan masanil tas swalkan tik t'ayex.

Ayik tze na'ank'e he chi'an nok' chib'ej, syal he milancham junok nok' heyiko' tze chi'an b'aj ayex ek' chi', hato syal tas syak' Jehová t'ayex. Wach'chom ayex wach' heyaji, icha yalan ley, mato ma'ay, syal he chi'ani, ichok tz'aj he chi'an junok nok' ch'ukul ma junok nok' k'ultakil chej.
Anhej wal schik'il nok' b'i'an, manh jab'ok syal he chi'ani, ma heyuk'ani, anhej to tze tob'kanem t'a sat lu'um ichok ha ha'.

Max yal he wa'an sdiezmo'al he trigo t'a yol he chonhab', ma sdiezmo'al he wino, heyaceite, ma he chi'an nok' b'ab'el yune' he wakax yet' b'ab'el yune' he kalnel, ma heyofrenda tzeyak' he ti' heyak'ani, ma he kolwal, ma heyofrenda tz'och b'akhan t'a yichanh Jehová.

Anhej t'a jun lugar ol sik'kanel Jehová ko Diosal, hata' ol he chi' juntzanh silab' chi', ajun heb' heyal heyuninal heyet'ok yet' heb' he chekab' yet' heb' levita ayek' t'a he kal. Hata' tzeyak' tzalajb'ok he k'o'ol t'a yichanh Jehová yuj tas syak' t'a he munlajel chi'.
Yakb'an ayex ek' t'a jun lu'um chi', mokab' b'at heb' levita satk'olal heyu'uj.
Ha wal yik ol lewanb'ok he lu'um yuj Jehová ko Diosal t'a jantak yak'nak sti' yak'ani, tato syal he k'o'ol ol he chi nok' chib'ej, ol yal he chi'an nok' t'a yalnhej tas k'uhal.

Tato najat kajan hex t'a jun lugar ol sik'kanel Jehová ko Diosal b'aj tz'och ejmelal chi', syal he milancham nok' he wakax yet' nok' he kalnel syak' Jehová chi' t'ayex b'aj kajan hex chi', tze chi'an nok' icha syal jantak snib'ej he k'o'ol, icha ix aj walan t'ayex.
Ichataxon tz'aj he chi'an yalnhej tas makanhil nok' k'ultakil chej, icha chi' tz'ajpax he chi'ani, tato wach' heyaj icha yalan ley, mato ma'ay, syalnhej he chi'an nok'.
Palta max yal-laj he chi'an nok' chib'ej max el-laj schik'il, yujto ha t'a schik'il nok' chi' ay sk'inal. Max yal-laj he chi'an nok' chib'ej chi' yet' sk'inal.
Anhej to tze tob'kanel schik'il nok' chi' t'a sat lu'um ichok ha ha'.
Manh he chi'a, manh heyuk'ej schik'il nok' nok' chi' yik wach'nhej ol hex ajelk'och yet' heyinhtilal yuj he k'anab'ajan Jehová.
Ha pax masanil tas to yikxo Dios yaj heyu'uj jun yet' tastak toxo ix heyak' he ti' heyak'ani, yowalil tzeyik'b'at t'a jun lugar ol sik'el Jehová.

Ha t'a yib'anh altar yik Jehová ko Diosal, hata' tzeyak' nok' he silab' to stz'a smasanil schib'ejal yet' schik'il nok'. Haxo pax junxo makan nok' he silab' jun, syal he chi'an schib'ejal nok', anhej wal schik'il nok' stob'chajkanoch t'a yich altar t'a yichanh Jehová.

Scham heyab'ani yet' he k'anab'ajan masanil tas swal tik, yik wach' wach'nhej ol aj he b'eyb'at yet' heb' heyinhtilal t'a masanil tiempo, yujto tze k'anab'ajej tas scha sk'o'ol Jehová ko Diosal, tojol hexnhej t'a yol sat.
Ayik ol satjokel masanil juntzanh chonhab' t'a heyichanh yuj Jehová ko Diosal, ha hexxo ol hex kajnajkan t'a sat slu'um heb' chi'.

Scham wal heyilani, manh hex b'at tzak'an t'a sb'eyb'al heb' icha tz'aj yak'anem sb'a heb' t'a sdiosal. Manh he k'anb'ej tas tz'aj yoch heb' ejmelal t'a sdiosal chi', yik wach' manh ichokta tzeyutejpax he b'a.

Manh ichok syutej sb'a heb' chi', manh ichok chi' tzeyutej he b'a t'a Jehová ko Diosal, yujto ha masanil tas sk'ulej heb' chi' chakb'ilel yuj. Ha juntzanh chi' haton sb'eyb'alej heb' anima chi' yik tz'och heb' ejmelal t'a sdiosal. Ay pax b'aj snhustz'a yal yuninal heb' silab'il t'a sdiosal chi'.
k'anab'ajejek he b'eyb'alan masanil tas swalkan tik t'ayex. Manh heyik'el jab'ok, manh heyak'paxoch stz'akub' juntzanh cheknab'il tik.
